title: Old Quebec private tour on foot and by vehicle
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our 50/50 formula stands out because it allows you to appreciate the beauty of Old Quebec on foot and by vehicle. The tour begins with a guided tour of Old Quebec at the walk lasting about 2 hours. This will allow you to appreciate the architecture, history and friendly atmosphere of the city. Then take a seat in our vehicles for the motorized portion of the tour. This part of the tour will allow you to continue your discovery of the city by having access to sites more distant from Old Quebec. The addition of these sites makes this tour a must during your stay in Quebec City.

Bench available: $10 each.
